summary: Retest of the 2 HIGH Óptica bugs from iteration 105 plus a clinic POS regression check (frontend only, Playwright, 1920x1080). Both bugs are fixed. (1) /optica/punto-venta: with Descuento 10% and no authorizer, Confirmar Venta shows the sonner toast 'Indique quién autoriza el descuento' and does not POST /api/optica/sales/v2. (2) After a successful sale with 10% and authorizer TEST_Gerente (subtotal 150 -> total 135, ORD-202610-0008), the discount % field is empty ('') on the next sale, the authorizer field is hidden because the discount is 0, and the total goes back to Q150. Clinic /punto-venta: no IVA line in totals or sale detail; the sale is blocked with a toast when there is no authorizer (no POST); with an authorizer the sale is created (VTA-20261029-0002); the discount resets after the sale; the detail shows 'Descuento (aut. TEST_Dr Autoriza) -Q30' with no IVA; IVA 32.4 is still stored in the DB.

minor.issue: Response returns descuento_monto=null and has no authorizer field. The DB stores descuento_monto=30 and descuento_autoriza='TEST_Dr Autoriza'. The response model omits them. Not blocking.

issues: Still open from iteration 105, a business-rule question: hidden IVA is added on top, so Subtotal Q300 - Descuento Q30 shows TOTAL Q302.40. The visible math does not add up. Confirm with the user.
